source.test: extractFromZip(jarURL:entryPath:) -- any failure (spawn/exit/empty) collapses to nil, same as no manifest found

files.name: Broken-2.0.jar
files.corruptBytes: this is not a zip file at all

notes: MSC 1 has no distinguished 'corrupt archive' state anywhere -- extractFromZip's unzip subprocess just fails (non-zero exit) and returns nil the same as a jar with no manifest entry at all, which is exactly what a filename-heuristic-only fallback already handles. This port's own native zip reader (msc_infrastructure::archive::read_entry_bytes) degrades the same way for a file whose bytes aren't a valid zip archive at all -- one unreadable jar never blanks the whole scan, and this specific jar still gets a filename-heuristic ModEntry rather than being silently dropped from the inventory.
